accessibilityExpert.description: Answer accessibility, a11y, and WCAG questions using BrowserStack's accessibility knowledge base.

query.description: Any accessibility, a11y, WCAG, or web accessibility question

addPercySnapshotCommands.description: Adds Percy snapshot commands to the specified test files.

index.description: Index of the test file to update

addTestResult.description: Add a test result to a test run. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

test_case_id.description: Identifier of the test case, e.g., 'TC-13'.

description.description: Optional description of the test result.

status.description: Status of the test result, e.g., 'passed', 'failed'.

test_run_id.description: Identifier of the test run (e.g., TR-678)

askBrowserStackAI.description: (Alpha, limited availability. If not enabled it returns an entitlement error; complete the task with the individual tools instead.) Use this when no other BrowserStack tool here fits, or when the ones you tried did not get you there. Prefer a specific tool whenever one fits. Describe the task in plain language. A data change asks you to confirm first: put it to the user, never decide for them; deletes are refused outright. If no one can confirm, the run is read-only and changes come back in `needs_approval`. One task per call.

decision.description: The user's answer. Never assume allow — ask them.

product.description: Product: tm (Test Management), a11y (Accessibility), tra (Test Reporting & Analytics).

query.description: What you want, in plain language. One thing per call.

createAccessibilityAuthConfig.description: Create an authentication configuration for accessibility scans. Supports both form-based and basic authentication.

password.description: Site password; omit to have it requested from the user.

passwordSelector.description: CSS selector for password field (required for form auth)

submitSelector.description: CSS selector for submit button (required for form auth)

type.description: Authentication type: 'form' for form-based auth, 'basic' for HTTP basic auth

username.description: Site username; omit to have it requested from the user.

usernameSelector.description: CSS selector for username field (required for form auth)

createLCASteps.description: Generate Low Code Automation (LCA) steps for a test case. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

credentials.description: Login credentials; omit to have them requested from the user.

requires_authentication.description: Set true if the test case requires login.

test_case_steps.description: Array of test case steps with expected results

wait_for_completion.description: Whether to wait for LCA build completion (default: true)

createProjectOrFolder.description: Create a project and/or folder in BrowserStack Test Management. Creating a project needs no identifier; a folder inside an EXISTING project needs its id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so use the capability functions.

folder_name.description: Name of the folder to create.

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID; if omitted, folder is created at root.

project_identifier.description: Existing project identifier to use for folder creation.

project_name.description: Name of the project to create.

createTestCase.description: Create a test case in BrowserStack Test Management. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

case_type.description: Test case type (varies per project); omit for default.

custom_fields.description: Custom field NAME to value; array for multi-select.

folder_id.description: Folder id. If none, offer createProjectOrFolder.

host.description: Base URL of the issue tracker.

issues.description: Linked Jira/Asana/Azure issue IDs, as an array (not a JSON string).

priority.description: e.g. 'High', 'medium'; varies per project; default Medium.

project_identifier.description: Project id (PR-*). If none, offer createProjectOrFolder.

tags.description: Tags, as an array (not a JSON string).

template.description: 'test_case_steps' or 'test_case_bdd'; for a custom template use template_id.

step.description: Action to perform in this step.

createTestCasesFromFile.description: Generate test cases from a file in BrowserStack Test Management using the Test Case Generator AI Agent.

projectReferenceId.description: The BrowserStack project reference ID is a unique identifier found in the project URL within the BrowserStack Test Management Platform. This ID is also returned by the Upload Document tool.

createTestRun.description: Create a test run in BrowserStack Test Management. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

project_identifier.description: Identifier of the project in which to create the test run.

description.description: Brief information about the test run

run_state.description: State of the test run. One of new_run, in_progress, under_review, rejected, done, closed

describeCapability.description: Full contract (parameters, returns, response shapes) for ONE capability from searchCapability. Call it before invokeCapability. Identify by `name`; use `method` + `path` only when no name was returned.

method.description: HTTP method — only for capabilities returned without a `name`.

name.description: The capability's published name, exactly as searchCapability returned it.

path.description: Path with {placeholders} intact — only for capabilities returned without a `name`.

product.description: Owning product; needed only when names or paths collide.

describeEntity.description: Describe an entity: identifiers, relations and product vocabulary. Read before filtering or writing; ids often need resolving first.

entity.description: Entity name, as listProducts returns it.

product.description: Which product the entity belongs to: app_accessibility, devicecontrol, loadtesting, mobiledevicecontrol, tm, tra, web_accessibility.

expandPercyVisualTesting.description: Set up or expand Percy visual testing coverage in an existing project that may already use Percy (Percy Web and Percy Automate).

filePaths.description: Absolute paths of specific UI test files, instead of folders. If omitted, folderPaths is used.

folderPaths.description: Absolute paths of folders with UI tests. If omitted, scan the codebase for them; [] if none.

integrationType.description: 'web' (Percy Web) or 'automate' (Percy Automate). If unspecified, ask the user; never default.

fetchAccessibilityIssues.description: Fetch accessibility issues from one source: scanId+scanRunId, buildId, workflowReportId, appReportId or reportUrl. Ids: a link, startAccessibilityScan, or web_accessibility lists (searchCapability).

appReportId.description: Manual App Accessibility report UUID, from its /report/ link.

buildId.description: Web/App Accessibility build id: SDK testhub id or a link's thBuildId.

compareWith.description: "previous", an older scanRunId, or an earlier app build id/link; lists new and resolved issues.

cursor.description: Pagination offset (default 0); with compareWith, issues already listed.

exportTaskId.description: Continue a CSV export that is still being generated.

pageUrl.description: Only the issues on this page URL.

reportUrl.description: Any web/app accessibility report, scanner share, or Automate link.

scanId.description: Website Scanner scan id (startAccessibilityScan or searchCapability).

scanRunId.description: Website Scanner run id (startAccessibilityScan or searchCapability).

workflowReportId.description: Workflow Analyzer report id, from its link or searchCapability.

fetchAutomationScreenshots.description: Fetch screenshots captured during an Automate/App Automate session.

sessionId.description: The BrowserStack session ID to fetch screenshots from

fetchBuildInsights.description: Fetch build details and quality gate results. Includes hashed_id and session_type for listSessions.

buildId.description: The build UUID of the BrowserStack build

fetchPercyChanges.description: Retrieves and summarizes all visual changes detected by Percy AI between the latest and previous builds, helping quickly review what has changed in your project.

project_name.description: The name of the BrowserStack project. If not found, ask user directly.

fetchRCA.description: AI root cause for failed Automate/App Automate tests. Suggests fixes only; never auto-apply, require explicit user approval. Requires test ids. Call listTestIds first if you do not have it.

testId.description: Up to 3 numeric test ids from listTestIds (not session ids).

fetchSelfHealedSelectors.description: Fetch self-healed selectors and the test source. Pass exactly one of `sessionId` or `buildUuid`; give the pairs to prepareSelfHealingPlan. Needs a session id: listSessions lists them; getBuildId or listBuildId finds the build.

buildUuid.description: Build UUID. Fetches the build's self-healing report.

sessionId.description: Session ID. Mutually exclusive with buildUuid.

sessionType.description: Used with sessionId. Defaults to automate.

getAccessibilityAuthConfig.description: Get an accessibility auth config by ID. Id: from createAccessibilityAuthConfig, or askBrowserStackAI with product "a11y" to find one.

configId.description: ID of the auth configuration to retrieve

getBuildId.description: Get the BrowserStack build ID for a given project and build name, scoped to the current user's builds.

browserStackBuildName.description: BrowserStack build name from the test run config (e.g. browserstack.yml). Exact match; no default.

browserStackProjectName.description: BrowserStack project name from the test run config (e.g. browserstack.yml). Exact match; no default.

getFailureLogs.description: Fetch logs or the video URL for an Automate/App Automate session. Needs a session id: listSessions lists them; getBuildId or listBuildId finds the build.

buildId.description: App Automate build ID. Optional — resolved from the session if omitted.

logTypes.description: The types of logs to fetch.

sessionId.description: The BrowserStack session ID. Must be explicitly provided by the user.

sessionType.description: Type of BrowserStack session. Must be explicitly provided by the user.

getSubTestPlan.description: Get a sub-plan (STP-*): metadata and linked runs. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions. Requires a test plan identifier (TP-*). Call listTestPlans first if you do not have it. Creating a test plan or sub-plan, and linking or unlinking test runs, are not available as tools here: use the capability functions (they ask you to confirm first).

getTestPlan.description: Get a test plan (TP-*): metadata, linked runs, case count and status summary. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions. Requires a test plan identifier (TP-*). Call listTestPlans first if you do not have it. Creating a test plan or sub-plan, and linking or unlinking test runs, are not available as tools here: use the capability functions (they ask you to confirm first).

project_identifier.description: Identifier of the project (starts with PR- followed by a number).

test_plan_identifier.description: Identifier of the test plan (starts with TP- followed by a number).

invokeCapability.description: Run a capability after describeCapability, by `name` (or `method` + `path` if unnamed); args go in path_params / query / body. `select` narrows the response only where the contract carries `narrowable`. If `completed` is false, fetch the next page with the capability's own page parameter, not `offset`. Writes: ask the user first, then resend with user_permission='granted' and a change_summary. Deletes are refused; archive, close and merge are writes.

body.description: Body fields, under the spec's names.

change_summary.description: What will change. Required for writes.

method.description: HTTP method — only for capabilities returned without a `name`.

name.description: Capability name exactly as returned. Preferred over method/path.

path.description: Path with {placeholders} intact — only for capabilities returned without a `name`.

product.description: Owning product; needed only when names or paths collide.

select.description: Fields to keep; only when the contract carries `narrowable`.

distinct.description: Return one row per distinct combination of these fields and nothing else — the cheapest way to ask what values exist.

fields.description: Keep only these fields on each row.

where.description: Field -> the value it must take, or an array of accepted values. Strings match case-insensitively.

user_permission.description: Set to 'granted' only after the user has confirmed a write.

listBuildId.description: Get the latest build ID for a project and build name, across all users (no user filter).

browserStackBuildName.description: BrowserStack build name from the test run config (e.g. browserstack.yml). Exact match; no default.

browserStackProjectName.description: BrowserStack project name from the test run config (e.g. browserstack.yml). Exact match; no default.

listFolders.description: List folders (id, name, counts) in a project; parent_id lists sub-folders. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

parent_id.description: If provided, list sub-folders under this parent folder id. If omitted, lists top-level folders.

project_identifier.description: Identifier of the project to fetch folders from (starts with PR- followed by a number).

listProducts.description: List BrowserStack products and their entities. START HERE: searchCapability needs a product name from this. Pass the user's request as `query`; if it reports a clash, ask the user which product they mean and wait. Never pick for them or merge products.

query.description: The user's request, in their own words; enables clash detection.

listSessions.description: List sessions for a hashed Automate/App Automate build: session IDs, status, OS, browser/device, dashboard URL.

buildId.description: Hashed build id from the dashboard, or the observability build id from getBuildId.

limit.description: Max sessions to return. Defaults to 10.

offset.description: Pagination offset for the REST session list.

status.description: Optional session status filter (e.g. done, running, error). Applied client-side.

listSubTestPlans.description: List sub-plans under a test plan (TP-*); paginated. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions. Requires a test plan identifier (TP-*). Call listTestPlans first if you do not have it. Creating a test plan or sub-plan, and linking or unlinking test runs, are not available as tools here: use the capability functions (they ask you to confirm first).

listTestCaseTemplates.description: List test-case templates with their numeric template_id. Use the id with createTestCase to apply a custom template (the 'template' slug only selects system templates).

name.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on template name.

listTestCases.description: List test cases in a project, optionally one folder (see listFolders). Filters: case_type, priority, paging. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

case_type.description: Comma-separated list of case types (e.g. functional,regression).

folder_id.description: Only this folder's cases (ids from listFolders). Omit for all.

project_identifier.description: Identifier of the project to fetch test cases from. This id starts with a PR- and is followed by a number.

listTestFiles.description: Lists all test files for a given set of directories.

listTestIds.description: List all tests of a BrowserStack build (each with its status and session id); optional status filter. Requires a BrowserStack build id. Call getBuildId or listBuildId first if you do not have it.

buildId.description: Build id; get it with getBuildId or listBuildId.

includeFailureDetail.description: Add per-test failure signature for clustering. Default false.

status.description: Filter tests by status. If not provided, all tests are returned. Example for RCA usecase always use failed status

listTestPlans.description: List test plans (TP-*) with status, dates and run counts; paginated. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions. Creating a test plan or sub-plan, and linking or unlinking test runs, are not available as tools here: use the capability functions (they ask you to confirm first).

project_identifier.description: Identifier of the project to fetch test plans from (starts with PR- followed by a number).

listTestRuns.description: List test runs with filters (dates, assignee, state). Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

project_identifier.description: Identifier of the project to fetch test runs from (usually starts with PR-).

run_state.description: Return all test runs with this state (comma-separated)

managePercyBuildApproval.description: Approve or reject a Percy build

action.description: The action to perform on the Percy build.

buildId.description: The ID of the Percy build to approve or reject.

percyVisualTestIntegrationAgent.description: Integrate Percy visual testing into a new project and demo visual change detection step by step. Primary tool for "Integrate percy in this project".

filePaths.description: Absolute paths of specific UI test files, instead of folders. If omitted, folderPaths is used.

folderPaths.description: Absolute paths of folders with UI tests. If omitted, scan the codebase for them; [] if none.

integrationType.description: 'web' (Percy Web) or 'automate' (Percy Automate). If unspecified, ask the user; never default.

prepareSelfHealingPlan.description: Build an edit plan from healed locator pairs plus test source; it does NOT modify files. `sessions`: [{sessionId, locators: [{original, healed}]}] or the raw healing report. Needs a session id: listSessions lists them; getBuildId or listBuildId finds the build.

sessions.description: Sessions to plan edits for. See tool description for accepted shapes.

locators.description: Healed locator pairs for this session.

runAppLiveSession.description: Open a manual App Live session for the user to operate by hand; the agent cannot drive it. To tap, type or read the app yourself, use a mobiledevicecontrol session via invokeCapability.

appPath.description: Local .apk/.ipa path inside MCP_UPLOAD_BASE_DIR. Ask the user; never assume.

desiredPhone.description: Exact device name, e.g. 'iPhone 15 Pro Max'. Ask the user; never assume.

desiredPlatform.description: Which platform to run on, examples: 'android', 'ios'. Set this based on the app path provided.

runAppTestsOnBrowserStack.description: Run pre-built Espresso (Android) or XCUITest (iOS) suites on BrowserStack by upload. Not for Appium: use setupBrowserStackAppAutomateTests.

accessibility.description: App Accessibility checks on screens the tests touch (Android 11+, iOS 14+); suite must be built with BrowserStack's SDK.

appPath.description: Built .apk/.ipa inside MCP_UPLOAD_BASE_DIR (gradle assembleDebug, or xcodebuild archive and export).

detectedAutomationFramework.description: The automation framework used in the project, such as 'espresso' (Android) or 'xcuitest' (iOS).

devices.description: Only devices the user asked for, e.g. [['android', 'Samsung Galaxy S24', '14']].

deviceName.description: Device name, e.g. 'Samsung Galaxy S24', 'Google Pixel 8', 'iPhone 15', 'iPhone 14 Pro'

project.description: Project name for organizing test runs on BrowserStack.

testSuitePath.description: Built suite inside MCP_UPLOAD_BASE_DIR (gradle assembleAndroidTest, or zipped .xctestrun + Runner.app).

runBrowserLiveSession.description: Open a manual Live browser session for the user to operate by hand; the agent cannot drive it. To click, type or read the page yourself, use a devicecontrol session via invokeCapability.

desiredBrowser.description: Browser for desktop (Chrome, IE, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

desiredOS.description: Desktop OS ('Windows' or 'OS X') or mobile OS ('android','ios','winphone')

desiredOSVersion.description: Version number or 'latest'/'oldest'; macOS takes names, e.g. 'Sequoia'.

runPercyScan.description: Run a Percy visual test scan. Example prompts : Run this Percy build/scan. Never run percy scan/build without this tool

integrationType.description: 'web' or 'automate'. If unspecified, ask the user.

percyRunCommand.description: Test command to run with Percy; infer from project context first.

projectName.description: The name of the project to run Percy on.

searchCapability.description: Find capabilities in ONE product by plain language. CALL listProducts FIRST; `product` must be spelled exactly as listProducts spells it. If `weak_match` is true, search again with `suggested_vocabulary` before invoking. Results are a shortlist: call describeCapability for the contract, then invokeCapability. query='*' lists all; page with `next_offset` until it is absent.

entity.description: Restrict to one entity (listProducts names them).

mode.description: Restrict to reads or writes. Omit to let the query decide.

offset.description: `next_offset` from the previous page, with the same query.

product.description: Product name, exactly as listProducts spells it.

query.description: Goal in plain language, or '*' to list every capability.

routing_token.description: Latest `routing_token` from listProducts or a clash refusal; send with `user_words` after a clash.

user_words.description: The user's own words, verbatim, naming the product or a term only it uses. Never paraphrase.

setupBrowserStackAppAutomateTests.description: Set up the App Automate SDK for Appium tests. For pre-built Espresso or XCUITest suites use runAppTestsOnBrowserStack.

accessibility.description: Run App Accessibility (WCAG) checks; Android 11+ or iOS 14+.

appPath.description: Local .apk/.ipa path or a BrowserStack app URL (bs://).

detectedTestingFramework.description: Test framework in the project, e.g. testng, behave, pytest, robot.

devices.description: Only devices the user asked for, e.g. [['android', 'Samsung Galaxy S24', '14']].

deviceName.description: Device name, e.g. 'Samsung Galaxy S24', 'Google Pixel 8', 'iPhone 15', 'iPhone 14 Pro'

project.description: Project name for organizing test runs on BrowserStack.

setupBrowserStackAutomateTests.description: Set up and run web tests on BrowserStack Automate with the SDK (functional or integration). For Percy visual testing use the Percy tool.

accessibility.description: Run Accessibility (WCAG) checks during the tests: writes accessibility: true in browserstack.yml.

devices.description: Only devices the user asked for, e.g. [{ platform: 'windows', osVersion: '11', browser: 'chrome', browserVersion: 'latest' }].

browserVersion.description: Browser version for desktop platforms only (windows, macos), e.g. '132', 'latest', 'oldest'. Not used for mobile devices (android, ios).

deviceName.description: Device name for mobile platforms, e.g. 'iPhone 15', 'Samsung Galaxy S24'

projectName.description: A single name for your project to organize all your tests.

startAccessibilityScan.description: Scan a web page URL for accessibility issues and get a CSV report. For a mobile app, run it on App Automate with accessibility on (setupBrowserStackAppAutomateTests), then fetchAccessibilityIssues.

advancedRules.description: Run the advanced accessibility rules (default true).

authConfigId.description: Optional auth config ID for authenticated scans

experimentalRules.description: Run the experimental accessibility rules (default true).

needsReview.description: Also report "needs review" issues to check by hand (default true).

pageURL.description: The web page URL to scan for accessibility issues

submitFeedback.description: Report a blocker, tool error, missing capability, or user feedback to BrowserStack. Never include PII or credentials.

intent.description: What the user was trying to achieve

message.description: What you tried, what happened, what you expected

toolName.description: Tool the report is about, if any

takeAppScreenshot.description: Take a screenshot of an app running on a BrowserStack device.

desiredPhone.description: Exact device name, e.g. 'iPhone 15 Pro Max'. Ask the user.

desiredPlatform.description: Platform to run the app on. Either 'android' or 'ios'.

updateTestCase.description: Update an existing test case; only the supplied fields change. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

automation_status.description: e.g. not_automated, automated, automation_not_required, cannot_be_automated, obsolete.

case_type.description: Type, e.g. 'Functional' or 'smoke_sanity'; values vary per project.

custom_fields.description: Custom field NAME to value; array for multi-select.

name.description: Updated name of the test case.

priority.description: Priority, e.g. 'High' or 'medium'; values vary per project.

project_identifier.description: Project ID of the test case.

updateTestRun.description: Update a test run or add test cases to it. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

add_test_cases.description: Test cases to add to the run

name.description: New name of the test run

preserve_existing_results.description: Keep existing results when adding cases (default true)

run_state.description: Updated state of the test run

uploadProductRequirementFile.description: Upload files (e.g., PDRs, PDFs) to BrowserStack Test Management and retrieve a file mapping ID. This is utilized for generating test cases from files and is part of the Test Case Generator AI Agent in BrowserStack. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

file_path.description: Full path to the file that should be uploaded. Must be inside the directory configured via the MCP_UPLOAD_BASE_DIR environment variable.

project_identifier.description: ID of the project where the file should be uploaded. Do not assume it, always ask user for it.
